user_query: I'm planning a family gathering and I need some entertainment options. Can you recommend some fun radio stations that cater to different musical tastes? Additionally, I would like to download some tracks from YouTube to create a customized playlist for the event.

TaskList.description: Research and recommend radio stations that cater to various musical tastes.
Gather a list of popular songs from YouTube suitable for the gathering.
Download the selected tracks from YouTube.
Compile the downloaded tracks into a customized playlist.
